Vermicelli Cutlets

Make this as your next patty whenever you are planning to make delicious burgers for your kids.

5 minPreparation
10 minCooking
2Servings

Ingredients

For 2 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a frying pan on medium heat. Add ginger paste and fry for 1 minute.
  2. Add grated carrot and green peas and cook till tender.
  3. Add all the spice powders and salt and stir well.
  4. Add the cooked vermicelli, chopped coriander and mashed potato.
  5. Add the Kissan Chilli Tomato Sauce and mix well. Shape portions of the mixture into desired shapes.
  6. Place a griddle (tawa) on medium heat and drizzle a little oil on it.
  7. Fry the cutlets on the griddle until both sides turn crispy and light brown.
